blurb: Trek & Trail offers guided sea kayaking tours including half-day sea caves tours, island day trips, and multi-day kayak camping expeditions. They rent tandem sea kayaks for experienced backcountry travelers who complete a safety course. Their tours include instruction, safety training, and food service on multi-day trips.
extraNote: No walk-in rentals; all rentals require prior safety course completion · In poor weather, refunds or credits may be given for rentals · Booking early with 50% deposit by January 31 recommended for groups · Groups must have minimum 7 participants for group trips · Refund provided if kayak test fit fails and guest decides not to go · No refunds if test fit skipped and guest cancels on trip day · Downtown Bayfield, WI, next to the Madeline Island Ferry dock · Memorial Day weekend through mid-September
